type.desc: Native type attribute (submit, reset, button) or 'a' for link behavior

icon-right.desc: Icon name following Quasar convention; placed on the right side

color.desc: Color name from the Quasar Color Palette

text-color.desc: Overrides text color (if needed); Color name from the Quasar Color Palette

square.desc: Removes border-radius so borders are squared

fab.desc: Makes button size and shape fit a Floating Action Button

fab-mini.desc: Makes button size and shape fit a small Floating Action Button

padding.desc: Custom padding (vertical [horizontal]); CSS units or size names (none|xs|sm|md|lg|xl)

no-caps.desc: Avoid turning label text into caps

stretch.desc: When on flexbox parent, stretches to parent's height

loading.desc: Put button into loading state (displays a QSpinner)

href.desc: Native <a> link href attribute; has priority over 'to' and 'replace'

target.desc: Native <a> link target attribute; use with 'to' or 'href'

percentage.desc: Percentage (0–100); used with 'loading' to display a progress bar on the background

dark-percentage.desc: Progress bar should have dark color; used with 'percentage' and 'loading'

size.desc: Size in CSS units, including unit name, or standard size name (xs|sm|md|lg|xl)

default.desc: Custom content, instead of relying on 'icon' and 'label' props

loading.desc: Override the default QSpinner when in loading state

click.desc: Emitted when the component is clicked
